candidates.file: File:Syracuse vs. USF football Boca Raton Bowl 2023 warmups.jpg
candidates.description: This image was taken at the 2023 Boca Raton Bowl on December 21, 2023, at FAU Stadium in Boca Raton, Florida . The 10th annual Boca Raton Bowl featured the 2024 Syracuse Orange football team of the Atlantic Coast Conference and the 2024 South Florida Bulls football team of the American Athletic Conference .
